The '''Mysess Glade''' was a sub-region of the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It was the location of the [[Great Tree (Kashyyyk)|Spirit of Nyenthi'Oris]], a great tree worshiped by the [[Kerritamba Village]]. It was also home to the [[Nyenthi'Oris Graveyard|village graveyard]]. It was named for the [[Mysess blossom/Legends|mysess blossoms]] that grew heavily in the area.
